Snapshot captured 491 nodes with 1 ref.
Title: Hero Football Manager
URL: http://127.0.0.1:8093/?qa=playtest

- document "Hero Football Manager"
  - text: "You need to enable JavaScript to run this app."
  - img "Noor Al-Khatib"
  - img "Thandi Mokoena"
  - text: "Season 6"
  - text: "THE CLIMB IS COMPLETE"
  - text: "Bramble Rovers · Global League and Hero Cup"
  - text: "Ace II"
  - text: "Boss. Before anyone else gets in here, thank you."
  - text: "You made me the player I am. Every bit of it came out of your coaching."
  - text: "We won the league. We won the Cup. I am glad we did."
  - text: "But it is not the trophies I will carry. It is the mornings on the training pitch, and the one man who kept turning up for me."
  - text: "Wherever this goes next, I got here with you. Thank you, boss."
  - text: "Bert Rudge"
  - text: "One last thing. This game was made by one man on his own, Joe Vu, and he thanks you very much."
  - text: "People like you are what let him make the next one. Keep an eye out for it."
  - button "Finish" [ref=@e1]
    - text: "Finish ›"
